title: 第25章 信士数量暴涨完成个人任务－肆＼第26章 九百多道神力开辟丙级灵田＼
slug: 全民成野神唯有我百倍供品
content_zh:
“人族武者？”
“桀桀桀——”
“老子最喜欢吃人族武者了，有嚼劲，气血充沛。”
“让我数一数——”
“一二三四五六七八九——”
“这么多人族武者？”
“看来我可以吃上好几顿了，其中竟然还有一阶极限的人族武者……”
巨大的狐妖舔了舔嘴唇，狐狸脸上满是贪婪之色。
虽然不太灵光的脑子让它数不清楚这里有多少人族武者。
但一眼看去就是很多。
全部抓起来！
这些都是最好的两脚羊！
它狐狸脸上浮现出狰狞，身上妖气瞬间冲出，化作了一条条血红绳索，要将李有鸣等人全部捆住。
“妖孽，找死。”
李有鸣目中杀气一闪。
他体内的‘炁’顿时涌动了起来。
大量炁按照特定方式运转，转眼在他面前形成了一片白色云雾。
白色云雾翻涌，挡在所有血红绳索之前。
血红绳索顿时被陷入白色云雾之中，无法穿透。
而下一刻——

李有鸣伸手一指。
一柄闪动着浓郁金色光辉的巨大金刀凭空浮现，一闪斩在狐妖身上！
“啊——！”
狐妖惨叫，一只手臂被斩断，鲜血直流。
而下一瞬——
足足五柄金刀浮空，化作五道金光不停斩在狐妖脖颈上！
狐妖竭尽全力以妖气阻拦。
但金刀锋利之极，五道金刀连绵而来，妖气根本阻挡不住！
只是一闪。
狐妖脖颈被斩断，脑袋都掉了下来！
滚烫的妖血喷得满地都是，无头尸体在原地站了一会才倒在了地上。
看到地上的狐妖尸体。
两名瘫倒在地的老者呆滞在了原地。
他们完全不敢置信。
content_en:
"Human warrior?"
"Jiejiejie——"
"I like to eat human warriors the most. They are chewy and full of vitality and blood."
"Let me count-"
"One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine—"
"So many human warriors?"
"It seems that I can eat several meals, and among them there are actually first-order extreme human warriors..."
The huge fox demon licked his lips, and the fox's face was full of greed.
Although his not very bright mind makes him unable to count how many human warriors there are.
But it’s a lot at first glance.
Catch them all!
These are the best two-legged sheep!
A ferocious look appeared on the fox's face, and the demonic aura rushed out of his body instantly, turning into blood-red ropes to tie up Li Youming and others.
"Monster, seeking death."
Li Youming's eyes flashed with murderous intent.
The 'qi' in his body suddenly surged.
A large amount of Qi moved in a specific way, forming a white cloud in front of him in an instant.
White clouds surged, blocking all the blood-red ropes.
The blood-red rope was immediately trapped in the white cloud, making it impossible to penetrate.
And the next moment——
Li Youming stretched out his hand.
A huge golden sword flashing with rich golden light appeared out of thin air, and struck the fox demon in a flash!
"Ah——!"
The fox demon screamed, one arm was cut off, and blood was flowing.
And the next moment——
Five golden knives floated in the air, turning into five rays of golden light and slashing at the fox demon's neck!
The fox demon tried its best to stop it with its demonic energy.
But the golden sword is extremely sharp, and five golden swords come in succession, and the evil spirit cannot stop it at all!
Just a flash.
The fox demon's neck was cut off and his head fell off!
Hot demon blood spurted all over the ground, and the headless body stood there for a while before falling to the ground.
Saw the body of the fox demon on the ground.
The two old men who collapsed on the ground were stunned.
They were in complete disbelief.
